rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with little force or in a gentle manner.

example.english: I lightly knocked on the door.

rows.note: Use this when “lightly” means not treating or handling something seriously, as in taking rudeness lightly.

example.english: He treats other people's criticism lightly.
example.traditional: 佢對人哋嘅批評唔認真咁睇。
